lines: Homura unleashed her huge spear with all her might.
Making a noise that didn't sound like paper, the demon's thick skin deflected the spear.
That went for my ninja sword, too. It barely inflicted any damage.
However, our attacks had been feints.
The second the demon tried to shift to a counterattack,
A paper drill that Mai had fired tore a big hole in its belly.
“We did it!” I thought, but only for a moment.
Accompanied by the demon's roar, paper gathered from the surrounding bookshelves, and blocked up the hole in its stomach.
「This is never gonna end, is it?!!」
「If only I had a lot more paper!」
Every time it was wounded, it gathered paper from all around to return itself to normal.
Homura and I were only able to keep it in check, and Mai couldn't deal decisive damage with the small amount of paper she had on hand.
The demon that ruled this book world was ridiculing us.
That meant it was deliberately taking our attacks, and then making a show of regenerating itself in front of our eyes, to try and sap our morale.
It was just like when we fought Draugr August, who had now become Chevalier's librarian.
It was that sorcerer, Barde Barde's M.O.
「What is Chevalier doing?! Has she not grasped our situation yet?!」
I talked to her over and over again through the bookmark I had received, but I couldn't reach her at all.
We needed that mage's power to do something about this losing situation, and yet...
「More important than that, how come I can't make flame?! Dammit!!」
Homura was also violently enraged. It was understandable, since her maximum power was being sealed off.
「Books're dry, so once they catch fire, they burn easy. If only we had that first spark!!」
In all likelihood, Homura was unable to emit her flames because fireproofing magic had been cast on this book world.
On the other hand, Mai's Paper Spirit powers were usable here as long as it was on paper she had brought herself.
In which case, if we used Mai's paper and abilities, and added Homura's powers to start a fire, we might create that first spark in this flameless book world.
「Nanase-san, can you make char cloth with your paper?!」
「You're gonna start a fire in here? Fun! Mai, it's somethin' flammable that lights the initial fire!」
「For paper, you want somethin' like tissue paper, where the fibres are thin an' dry, and maximize the surface area that the oxygen touches!」
That was a Fire Escape user for you. Homura had grasped my aim instantly, and accordingly, Mai had also started making char paper.
I took a book off a shelf, spread its pages, which didn't have anything written on them, and drew my sword's wooden scabbard to use as a fire stick.
「Homura! Combustion power, over here! Mai, you maintain the heat that's built up in the tinder!」
The paper demon was still making a sneering smile, asking what we powerless people could do.
We were going to make that smile freeze in place.
I rubbed the tip of the scabbard against the book that the tinder had been placed on with all my might.
「Goooo!! Fire Escape Art!! Hurry up and catch fiiiire!!」
Homura's Fire Escape power and Mai's Paper Spirit power concentrated on the end of the sheath I was rubbing against it,
And a very faint, but unmistakable, fire was created.
Mai reflexively made a shout of joy at the flame, which should have been abhorrent to a Paper Spirit user.
「Ha-haaaaaaa!! Now we got the strength of a hundred people!!」
For Homura, this was pure ecstasy.
The flames spread to the whole book in no time, and even made Homura's spear flare up bright red.
The paper demon had clearly recoiled at the flames, which shouldn't have existed in this book world.
「You're gettin' the jitters, aren'tcha, paper asshole?!! Take this too!! Ninja Art: Fire Escape Spear Flame Formation!!!」
As if to vent all her frustration up until now, Homura unleashed a huge flame attack.
The paper devil's whole body burst into flames, and for the first time, it screamed.
However, it wasn't like the fireproofing magic that had been cast on this book world was gone.
The demon's flame was instantly extinguished, and the rustling paper that gathered from the bookshelves repaired its scorched body.
『In that case, let us make it a larger fire, shall we?』
All of a sudden, a voice was heard from our bookmarks.
『Sorry about that. Thanks to you creating fire in that world, Chevalier was finally able to interfere with the magic trap.』
『Now, you should be able to manipulate the books there with Paper Spirit powers. Set them on fire all you like, as well.』
Books flew off their shelves all at once.
Tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, no, more than that. It was an amount that dwarfed the paper demon.
「It's futile. The paper here is mine now.」
「I will show you the true power of a Paper Spirit user!! Paper Spirit: Phoenix!!」
Mai raised both hands up high. An enormous paper phoenix was formed overhead.
It was unlike the grubby-looking demon. It was a pure-white phoenix, without a single blemish.
It flared up brightly. It truly was a phoenix.
Engulfed by the beautifully flapping phoenix, the paper demon was burned away to nothing in an instant.
We had been freed from the magic trap, and finally returned to our original world.
The grimoire had been completely reduced to ashes.
「It would appear that this book itself was a trap. In case it was read by a stranger.」
「That's why it was a library catalogue?」
「The thing which one would ordinarily skim over first. Chevalier wouldn't fall for a trap like that.」
「But you told me to trigger it on purpose.」
「A fool who falls for a trap unwittingly and a wise person who knowingly goes along with it are as different from each other as heaven is from earth.」
「Didn't you say wise people don't voluntarily cast magic on themselves?」
「You're right. I got to have a conversation I'm not usually able to have, and it was pretty fun.」
「You've gotten pretty friendly. And your teamwork since you linked up was excellent too.」
「Well, even if we are flame and paper—a terrible match—we have got one or two things in common, after all.」
Homura and Mai were exchanging smiles, as though they were different people from before they entered the book.
「I am too. But you absolutely, positively must not generate any flames inside, okay?」
「I toldja I won't, ya know? I'll burn your paper, punk!」
「I burned it the other day, didn't I?」
「Oi, wait a sec! This is my first time goin' there, remember?」
「There's no need to be especially nervous. Come on, come on, I'm going to leave you behind!」
And so the two of them, Homura and Mai, a Fire Escape user and a Paper Spirit user, goofed around as they headed to the National Diet Library.
